title: Induction Machine Direct Torque Control (Single-Phase)
text: Single-phase induction machine direct torque control, 4 inputs, 2 outputs; {Control mode}, {Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} sets the rated electrical frequency, {Number of pole pairs}, {Main winding stator resistance, Ras (Ohm)} sets the main winding stator resistance, {Auxiliary winding stator resistance, Rbs (Ohm)} sets the auxiliary winding stator resistance, {Auxiliary/main windings turn ratio} sets the auxiliary-to-main windings turn ratio, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time, {Speed controller proportional gain} sets the speed controller proportional gain, {Speed controller integral gain} sets the speed controller integral gain, {Speed controller integral anti-windup gain} sets the speed controller integral anti-windup, {Maximum torque (Nm)} sets the maximum torque, {Minimum torque (Nm)} sets the minimum torque, {Rated flux (Wb)} sets the rated flux, {Flux hysteresis band (Wb)} sets the flux hysteresis band and {Torque hysteresis band (Nm)} sets the torque hysteresis band. Values come from the instance.
